title: A Warm Bowl from Chef Gut
text: Chef Gut is warming things up today! Lentil soup brings fiber to the table!
speaker: Chef Gut

title: Start with Precooked Lentils
text: One cup of cooked lentils, half an onion, and three hundred fifty milliliters of water. Add a teaspoon of oil.
speaker: Narrator

title: 01 Finely Chop the Onion
text: Finely chop the onion. Small pieces soften quickly in our soup!
speaker: Chef Gut

title: 02 Soften the Onion First
text: Add oil to a pot. Soften the onion over medium-low heat for about three minutes.
speaker: Narrator

title: 03 Add Lentils and Simmer
text: Add the cooked lentils and water! Bring to a boil, then simmer gently for about seven minutes.
speaker: Chef Gut

title: Divide into Two Bowls
text: Once the onion is tender, divide into two bowls. Season lightly with salt and pepper if you like.
speaker: Narrator

title: Why Gut Chose Lentils
text: Lentils provide fiber. Fiber and enough fluids help soften stools and support easier bowel movements.
speaker: Narrator

title: How Much Fiber in One Bowl?
text: Increase fiber gradually rather than all at once. Remember to drink water too!
speaker: Narrator

title: Spoons, Join the Queue!
text: Spoons, please join the queue! One of these bowls is mine!
speaker: Chef Gut

title: Screenshot Your Next Warm Bowl
text: Subscribe for your employee badge! Likes are your bonus!
speaker: Chef Gut
